component-type.dataviz.$behaviour.dv-ren.$description: The BULLET TYPE PARTIAL for dv-render — one KPI per ROW: a measure bar read against a comparative target marker, with the qualitative performance bands behind both. Registered #260 as the first of the s259-D1 fast-follower types. The value axis runs ACROSS x (fn.axis = "x", the horizontal-bar arm of the core's furniture switch) and fn.domain returns the RANGE TOP rather than the largest measure, because a bullet is read against its bands — the one thing the core cannot infer from `series` alone. Enacts #96-D1 ② (row pitch 60px, the RULED constant, CAPPED and never stretched, so filtering a row out leaves the survivors' bands identical), #96-D1 ③ (the canon greys --dv-range-1/2/3, minted nothing, and a fourth band throws because a fourth token does not exist), the brief-ruled bindings (measure = data/series/1, marker = ink) and the bands→bar→marker z-order, which in SVG is DOM order and nothing else. Carries ONE spec extension, `ranges`, declared and validated by the partial itself — a bullet without its qualitative bands is a horizontal bar. ⚠ Discards the core's cartesian furniture (ctx.out.length = 0, the donut/sparkline work-around) and emits the one piece a bullet owns, the vertical zero baseline; core request filed at knowledge/_tmp/260/bullet.core-requests.md. requires `data-dv-type="` — the same declaration every type partial owes, so a consumer that carries a type partial has said which type it draws.
